# Grant Radar

> Open U.S. federal grants, sorted by deadline, amount and who can apply — with plain-English guides to applying.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [How to Write Grants for Nonprofits: Federal Proposal Guide](https://aobaworks.com/grant-radar/how-to-write-grants-for-nonprofits-federal-proposal-guide/): Learn how to write grants for nonprofits the way federal reviewers score them: needs statement, goals, budget narrative, and Grants.gov submission steps.
- [How to Apply for Grants for Small Business (2026 Guide)](https://aobaworks.com/grant-radar/how-to-apply-for-grants-for-small-business-2026-guide/): How to apply for grants for small business in 2026: set up SAM.gov, get your UEI, register on Grants.gov, filter by eligibility, and submit before the deadline.
- [How to Check SAM.gov Registration Status (Step by Step)](https://aobaworks.com/grant-radar/how-to-check-sam-gov-registration-status-step-by-step/): Learn how to check SAM.gov registration status in Workspace or the public entity search, what Active, Inactive and Submitted mean, and what to do next.
